lore.description: This sidearm has been modified to fire a dart filled with a powerful sedative. The weapon’s long range is halved and it no longer deals HP damage. Instead, the target must succeed at a constitution save (DC 10 + Weapon tech level) or suffer 1d3 levels of exhaustion. A character who suffers exhaustion from this ailment is not dead when they reach 6 exhaustion, but instead unconscious (assuming they weren’t already unconscious). Exhaustion from this effect heals at a rate of 1 level per hour.

details.special: DC12 CON Save or 1d3 level of exhaustion. Level 6 exhaustion with this weapon will make the target unconscious.
